translations./garage/heading: Try the Same Route Another Way
translations./garage/brief: The same forklift corridor, now with a tighter budget. RO-1 has proved the route; this time, test a different motor and sensing combination.
translations./prediction/hint: Record a prediction. It does not affect the score; the run will give you evidence to test it.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: More motor force always means a faster run
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Motor and computer must work together. High torque with slow prediction updates can increase collision risk; inspect the waiting events.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: An efficient build can still arrive on time
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: An efficient motor and tires save energy. Test whether they can preserve the safety badge too.
translations./prediction/choices/2/text: Put the forklift in the static map
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: The forklift moves. A static map represents fixed obstacles, not where a moving object will be next.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Navigation stable. Approaching the signal tower.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Forklift tracked. Predicting its path.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Same road, different build, and RO-1 still delivered.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Select evidence on the right to jump the field view to that moment.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: These entries come from events and state recorded during this simulation run.
